subject: Where things stand
opener: Thanks for the time today. Quick check on where things stand.

bullets.text: On the demo call I promised the SOC 2 report and the TCPA one-pager to your office manager by Friday.
The one-pager never showed up and your office manager asked twice. That one is on me.
From the pricing call I still owe you a sharper number and the porting proof.
I am sending the TCPA one-pager to your office manager today.
You get the pilot proposal on paper this week, with the sharper number in it.

close: Every line above came from something said on a call. If I got any of it wrong, tell me and I will fix it.
